honing_confound: Esoteric skill damage scales with Specialization stat (gear-honing indexed). Orb fill speed depends on Swiftness. Tier standing reflects T4 meta where Esoteric skill burst output at 4 orbs is substantial.

delivery.evidence: Wardancer is a melee martial artist. Esoteric Skills are large-radius kicks/chi techniques with AoE delivery. Sky Shattering Blow, Heavenly Hunt, Blast Formation are primary Esoteric skills — these are wide AoE melee-range burst attacks.

footprint.evidence: Esoteric skills create large AoE at melee range — multiple-hit spin attacks, wide cone kicks. Wider footprint than most melee classes. ESE identity emphasizes these large-radius skills.

geo_text: ESE Wardancer is the AoE martial artist identity. At 4 Esoteric orbs, Esoteric skills gain massive damage bonuses (damage scales with orb count). Skills like Sky Shattering Blow and Blast Formation create wide AoE at melee range. The identity rhythm: build 4 orbs via fast combo skills → unleash Esoteric AoE burst → rebuild.

control.evidence: Some Wardancer skills apply knockback. Primary identity is DPS, not CC.

defense.evidence: Wardancer has very high mobility — fastest ground movement in warrior archetype (technically MA not warrior). Defense comes from mobility and dash evade rather than mitigation. Flash Step and similar evade skills.

economy.builder_source: Normal combo skills (Roundup Sweep, Storm Dragon Kick, Heavenly Beat) generate Esoteric orbs. Each skill generates 1 orb; some generate 2. Max 4 orbs.
economy.plain_text: 4-ORB CYCLE: Normal skills generate Esoteric orbs (up to 4). Esoteric Skills CONSUME orbs. ESE IDENTITY: Esoteric skill damage scales with orbs consumed at the time of cast — 4 orbs = maximum damage. The identity incentivizes SAVING orbs for full-orb Esoteric casts rather than spending at 1-2 orbs.

element.evidence: Wardancer skills have lightning and wind elemental aesthetics. Exact LA damage type is Physical/Magical — chi-based skills may be either.

movement.evidence: Wardancer has excellent mobility. Several skills include dashes as part of the attack animation. Flash Step is a repositioning dash. High movement speed class.

attr.evidence: All melee — but with wide AoE from chi-enhanced kicks.

range.evidence: Esoteric skills have larger AoE radius than standard martial arts (~5-8m). Normal skills are arm/leg reach range.

tempo.evidence: ESE is the burst identity: save orbs for full-4-orb Esoteric skill bursts. Between bursts = orb generation phase.

amp.value: Esoteric skills: damage scales with orb count (peak at 4 orbs); ESE identity further amplifies full-orb Esoteric skill damage
amp.evidence: Training knowledge; specific multipliers at 4 orbs not confirmed from live sources in this session. Conf 0.85.

commitment.evidence: Key Esoteric skills (Sky Shattering Blow, Blast Formation) have wind-up animations — the chi-charge before the burst. Normal combo skills are faster.

mechanics_notes: 1) ESE is the Wardancer identity where chi/Esoteric energy is the PRIMARY output mechanism — Normal skills exist to charge the orbs, Esoteric skills are the actual damage. Contrast with FI where Esoteric Skills are removed and Normal skills become the permanent damage. 2) Wardancer is the female counterpart to Striker (same archetype, different model). ESE Wardancer uses the same 4-orb system as Striker Esoteric Flurry but with different skill expressions. 3) Wide AoE at melee range is unusual — most melee classes have narrow footprints. ESE Wardancer's Esoteric skills create a 'melee AoE burst' pattern useful for grouped enemies. 4) The 4-orb patience discipline is a skill expression: rush and use Esoteric at 2 orbs for more frequent smaller bursts, or wait for 4 for maximum single-window damage. ESE identity pushes toward patience (wait for 4).
stabilization_patch: ESE was dominant in group-mob content (chaos dungeons, Cube) due to AoE advantage. FI became preferred for boss content. Both have fluctuated with balance patches.
tier_standing_current: A/B-tier (meta preference leans toward FI for boss raids). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Esoteric skill damage ceiling scales with Specialization; significant gear dependency for full-orb burst output.

honing_confound: First Intention provides a flat +20% damage bonus to all Normal skills — this stacks multiplicatively with gear damage bonuses. The flat bonus makes FI LESS honing-dependent in structure but still scales absolutely with base damage from honing.

delivery.evidence: Same melee skill set as ESE but using Normal skills ONLY. Esoteric skills are disabled. Normal skills include: Roundup Sweep, Storm Dragon Kick, Heavenly Beat, Sweeping Kick — all melee combo attacks.

footprint.evidence: Normal skills (no Esoteric AoE) are narrower-footprint than ESE skills — kicks and combos in front of the caster rather than wide chi bursts.

geo_text: FI Wardancer is the sustained high-speed martial artist identity. Esoteric skills are disabled (orb system dormant). All damage comes from fast-cycling Normal skill combos. High movement speed and attack speed from FI buff enables continuous melee engagement with minimal downtime.

control.evidence: Same as ESE. FI has no CC focus.

defense.evidence: Same high-mobility defensive profile as ESE.

economy.resource_verbatim: No Esoteric Meter (FI disables the orb system)
economy.builder_source: N/A — FI DISABLES the Esoteric Meter. All skills are Normal skills on independent cooldowns.
economy.plain_text: COOLDOWN ECONOMY: FI removes the Esoteric meter entirely. All skills fire on independent cooldowns. No orb generation, no orb spending. First Intention engraving: +20% damage to all Non-Esoteric skills + significant Attack Speed bonus. The identity is 'always attacking, never waiting for orbs.' Extremely simple resource management — fire skills as they come off cooldown.

element.evidence: Same as ESE — chi-powered physical/magical damage.

movement.evidence: Same high mobility as ESE. Attack speed bonus from FI makes movement between skill casts feel even faster.

attr.evidence: Melee only. No Esoteric AoE range.

range.evidence: Normal skills are melee/arm-reach range, narrower than ESE's Esoteric chi AoE.

tempo.evidence: FI is the sustained identity: no burst windows, no orb gates, continuous Normal skill cycling. 'The original version of yourself, fighting with your sheer martial arts skills and none of the Esoteric enhancements' — literally 'no identity system active = pure sustained output.'

amp.value: +20% damage to all Non-Esoteric skills; significant Attack Speed bonus
amp.evidence: Training knowledge: First Intention = +20% Non-Esoteric damage (all Normal skills). This is a passive flat multiplier, not a burst window.

commitment.evidence: Normal skills have short animations (faster than Esoteric skills). FI's attack speed bonus further reduces effective commitment time.

mechanics_notes: 1) First Intention is one of the SIMPLEST identity concepts in the game: remove the complex Esoteric orb system, add a flat damage bonus and attack speed. The design philosophy is 'pure martial arts without the chi energy gimmick.' 2) FI vs ESE represents a 'simple sustained vs complex burst' fork common in LA design (similar to Reflux/Igniter for Sorceress). The same base class with orthogonal identity philosophies. 3) FI is the preferred boss-fight identity because its sustained output is consistent regardless of boss positioning (ESE loses value if the caster can't maintain uptime for orb generation). 4) The Attack Speed bonus on FI makes it FEEL very different from ESE in play — the class becomes almost twitchy in its rate of skill usage. This experiential difference (feel) is notable even if schema-level output differences are modest.
stabilization_patch: FI has been preferred for boss raids since early global; ESE preferred for mob clearing. Relative tier fluctuates but FI is generally considered more 'endgame viable.'
tier_standing_current: A-tier (boss raids). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: flat +20% bonus stacks with gear — higher honing = higher absolute bonus but same relative structure.
